outputText: Subject: Empty industrial interior with scattered debris and a faint smoke plume near the center. Visible transformation: Introduction of a subtle smoke or mist rising near the center partition, adding atmospheric tension. Continuity: Maintain the empty, industrial spatial layout with exposed ceiling infrastructure and scattered debris; preserve the low partition as a central visual anchor and the faint smoke as a transitional element into the next scene.
